priorityList: Use Celestial Brew when the Aspect of Harmony Spender buff is active to maximize your shield.
Invoke Niuzao the Black Ox on cooldown for significant AoE damage and mitigation.
Cast Keg Smash as your highest priority for AoE damage and to generate Brew charges.
Cast Empty the Cellar if Aspect of Harmony is talented and Celestial Brew has more than 15 seconds remaining on cooldown.
Use Exploding Keg if Keg Smash is not at maximum charges.
Maintain the Blackout Combo buff by using Blackout Kick whenever it is available.
Use Purifying Brew frequently to clear Stagger and maintain defensive stability.
Cast Breath of Fire on cooldown, prioritizing windows when Niuzao is active or Flurry Strikes is triggered.
Use Black Ox Brew if you are low on Energy or to immediately recharge Celestial Brew.
Use Chi Burst on cooldown for additional AoE burst damage.
Maintain Rushing Jade Wind for constant passive AoE damage.
Use Tiger Palm to consume Blackout Combo buffs or to prevent capping your Energy.
Cast Fortifying Brew as your primary long-term defensive cooldown.
Use Expel Harm for self-healing or as a low-priority rotational filler.
Activate racial combat buffs (like Blood Fury or Berserking) and potions during high-intensity combat windows.
